title.en: Claude Duet: Anthropic’s Proactive AI Agent

excerpt.zh: Claude Duet是Anthropic推出的主动式AI助手，可生成每日简报并代办任务；敏感操作仍需用户批准，但研究预览仍可能误判紧急程度，目前仅限美国Pro和Max用户候补体验。
excerpt.en: Claude Duet is Anthropic’s proactive AI agent for briefings and delegated work, with approval gates and research-preview limits for US Pro and Max users.

text.zh: Claude Duet把聊天变成持续协作
text.en: Claude Duet turns chat into ongoing collaboration

text.zh: Claude Duet是Anthropic推出的主动式AI代理，不只是等待用户提问。它可以每天早晨汇总收件箱、日历和业务信号，指出需要关注的事项；用户也能通过文字或语音交代任务，让它在云端计算机中继续工作，并在完成或需要决定时回来通知。
text.en: Claude Duet is Anthropic’s proactive AI agent rather than a chatbot that simply waits for prompts. It can prepare a morning brief from connected work signals, identify items that need attention, and accept tasks by text or voice. It then continues working on a cloud computer and returns when the work is finished or a decision is required.

text.zh: 从简报到业务任务的Claude Duet
产品页面展示的场景包括安排会议、制作仪表盘、整理融资材料、准备邮件和合同，以及从销售点系统、Shopify、客户关系管理、客服、薪资和银行数据中生成经营概览。它支持超过6,000个连接器和插件，并沿用Claude账户中的记忆、技能与应用。敏感操作如发送消息或付款仍会请求批准。
text.en: The examples include scheduling meetings, building dashboards, preparing fundraising materials, drafting emails and contracts, and producing a business pulse from point-of-sale, Shopify, CRM, support, payroll, and banking data. Anthropic says it works with more than 6,000 connectors and plugins and carries over the user’s Claude memory, skills, and apps. Sensitive actions such as sending messages or making payments still require approval.

text.zh: 这意味着AI助手的价值重点从单次答案转向持续的任务编排：用户可以先设定目标，再审阅结果或关键节点。审批、登录和安全检查据称在用户自己的云端计算机中运行，用户也能查看代理正在做什么以及已经完成什么；不过这些设计并不等于结果天然可靠。
text.en: The broader shift is from one-off answers to continuing task orchestration: users set an objective, then review outputs or important checkpoints. Anthropic says approvals, logins, and safety checks run in the user’s own cloud computer, while activity remains visible for steering. Those controls, however, do not make the results inherently reliable.

text.zh: Claude Duet的开放问题与使用范围
Claude Duet目前是研究预览版，采用候补名单模式，面向美国的Claude Pro和Max用户；Team与Enterprise计划尚未包含。它的后台检查会消耗现有套餐额度，大型任务需要更多模型调用。Anthropic也明确提示，代理可能误读对话、错误判断紧急程度，或在两次检查之间漏掉新信息。因此，真正的考验不是能否完成演示任务，而是在复杂、连续且高风险的工作中，用户是否能有效监督它。
text.en: Claude Duet is currently a research preview on a waitlist for Claude Pro and Max subscribers in the United States; Team and Enterprise plans are not included. Background checks share the account’s normal usage limits, and larger tasks consume more model turns. Anthropic also warns that the agent may misread a thread, misjudge urgency, or miss something that arrives between check-ins. The key open question is therefore not whether it can complete polished demos, but whether people can supervise it effectively across complex, ongoing, and higher-stakes work.
